entry.title: UniFi Access Point (all U7 and E7 models) 8.7.11
entry.summary:
Overview Roaming Improvements
Smoother, more reliable WiFi roaming with improved transitions between access points. Access points can now discover and advertise neighboring APs that aren’t directly within wireless range, improving roaming performance in sparsely populated deployments, alongside other roaming reliability enhancements.
Force WiFi 4 Mode
Wireless networks can now be configured to operate in WiFi 4 mode, improving compatibility with legacy WiFi clients that may experience connectivity or interoperability issues with newer standards.
For the best balance of performance and legacy device support, we recommend using a dedicated WiFi broadcast for legacy clients.
Extended VLAN support on U7 In-Wall

entry.title: UniFi Access Point for U7-LR 8.0.74
entry.summary:
Improvements
Improved client connectivity and roam event reporting. Improved Auto-Link compatibility. Improved connectivity for legacy IoT clients. Improved stability.
Bugfixes
Fixed an issue where Auto Channel Selection on 2.4 GHz could select restricted channels. Fixed connectivity issues where UDB-IoT clients could not access the internet. Fixed an issue where UDB-IoT clients could not reach DVLAN clients on UAP devices. Fixed an issue where bandwidth was not synchronized on meshed APs. Fixed an issue causing clients to get stuck in a roaming loop between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz. Fixed an issue where clients could not connect using OWE. Fixed an issue where SSIDs failed to broadcast when MLO and Fast Roaming were enabled. Fixed an issue where OWE association could cause the AP to reboot. Fixed an issue where Lock to AP failed to keep clients locked after roaming. Fixed an issue where the 2.4 GHz radio continued broadcasting after being disabled. Fixed an issue where Fast Roaming could cause SSIDs to fail to broadcast. Fixed an issue where MLO clients could create ghost clients in the clients list.
Additional information Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Release Candidate.
If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:
AP model(s) Previous AP release version UniFi Network application version
